title: Country card
description: One record per country. What the cards show: the numbers in 'call' (label, number, and a short 'when' line), the 'checked' date, and, on the on-screen card only, a collapsed list of 'sources' and the 'notices' credit lines. The on-screen card, the A5 page 'Call, then act' and the wallet card all draw from this one record. Everything in 'extra' and each number's 'note' is kept for re-checking and later use and is NOT shown on any card. File name is the lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example ae.json. Every fact lists the ids of the sources behind it ('sources'), and every source carries its address, title and the date it was opened ('checked'). A number or fact with no confirmed official source is left out, never shown with a doubt marker. Facts are written in our own words; sources whose terms forbid copying text (NCEMA, u.ae, BBK, NCCN) are credited, not quoted.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case. Matches the file name.

name.description: Country name as shown on the card.

checked.description: Date every source on the record was last opened and read (YYYY-MM-DD). Equals the latest 'checked' among the sources. The on-screen card shows it; a build step can flag cards older than a set age.

call.description: Emergency numbers, in the order they should be shown. The on-screen card and the A5 page list all of them, each with its label and 'when' line; the wallet card takes those with wallet=true, with the 'short' label only.

extra.description: Facts kept in the record but not shown on any card: notes on the numbers, how alerts reach people, country-specific first steps, key authorities, hazards and climate. Re-checked with the numbers.

call_notes.description: Not shown on any card. Short notes under the numbers (how a number behaves, when not to call it, texting options, apps).

alerts.description: Not shown on any card. How a warning reaches people in this country: phone alerts, sirens, radio, apps, where to register. Plain statements, most important first.

first_steps.description: Not shown on any card. Steps that are specific to this country (not general first aid). Each one an instruction, first word a verb.

authorities.description: Not shown on any card. Key national bodies a reader may need to find. 'url' is the body's own site and is set only where an opened source page gives it.

hazards.description: Not shown on any card. Main hazards, stated only as far as an official page or the CIA World Factbook, final edition (23 January 2026), via worldfactbookarchive.org says. Left out when no source supports a line.

climate.description: Not shown on any card. One line on climate. Omitted when not sourced.

notices.description: Credit or terms lines a source requires, for example a copyright line. Shown only inside the collapsed Sources list on the on-screen card.

sources.description: Every page the record rests on. Ids are referenced by the facts. Shown only in the collapsed Sources list on the on-screen card; never on the A5 page or the wallet card.

source_ids.description: Ids of entries in the record's 'sources' list.

label.description: Full label for the screen card and the A5 page.

short.description: Label for the wallet card, at most 24 characters.

number.description: The number as people dial it. Digits, spaces and a leading + only.

when.description: A few words saying when to call this number, in plain words (for example 'Fire, or an ambulance'). Shown under the label on the on-screen card and the A5 page.

wallet.description: True if the number goes on the wallet card. At most five per country.

note.description: Optional remark kept for later use. Not shown on any card.

title.description: Title of the page as it shows.

updated.description: The date the page itself shows as updated or reviewed, when it shows one.

checked.description: The date we opened this page and read the facts from it.

note.description: Anything a reader of the footnote should know, for example an out-of-date review date on the page.
